messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023. Note that some provinces/territories have additional holidays, but the following are the nationwide long weekends:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | (No long weekend – falls on Sunday) |
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | Monday | Observed holiday because Jan 1 was Sunday |
| **January 16** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Monday | (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) |
| **February 20** | Louis‑Riel Day (Manitoba) | Monday | (Manitoba only) |
| **March 20** | Good Friday | Friday | (All provinces) |
| **March 23** | Easter Monday | Monday | (Only in federal government & some provinces) |
| **April 7** | Victoria Day | Monday | (All provinces) |
| **May 22** | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia) | Monday | (BC only) |
| **June 19** | Canada Day | Saturday | (No long weekend – falls on Saturday) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | (No long weekend – falls on Saturday) |
| **July 3** | Canada Day (Observed) | Monday | Observed holiday because July 1 was Saturday |
| **August 7** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Monday | (Ontario, NB, PEI, NS, NL) |
| **September 18** | Labour Day | Monday | (All provinces) |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Monday | (All provinces) |
| **November 10** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | (Observed because Nov 11 was Tuesday) |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | (All provinces) |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | (All provinces) |

### Long Weekend Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates | Holiday(s) |
|--------------|-------|------------|
| **New Year’s** | Jan 1–3 (Observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day |
| **Family Day** | Jan 16 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) |
| **Good Friday** | Mar 20 | Good Friday |
| **Easter Monday** | Mar 23 | Easter Monday (federal & some provinces) |
| **Victoria Day** | Apr 7 | Victoria Day |
| **Civic Holiday** | Aug 7 | Civic Holiday (Ontario, NB, PEI, NS, NL) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 18 | Labour Day |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Thanksgiving |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 10 | Remembrance Day (observed) |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 | Christmas Day |

These are the key dates you can use for your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific holidays beyond the ones listed, let me know!
message.reasoning: The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch that info. We can provide a list. There's no tool needed. Just answer.
